infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PeacePlot uses the camera for face check-ins and finger pulse check-ins; the back camera and flash may be used where needed. Photos and video frames are processed on your device for stress estimation.

plugins.microphonePermission: PeacePlot uses the microphone only to record short voice samples for stress check-ins—not for music or background listening.

plugins.cameraPermission: PeacePlot uses the camera for a one-time face check-in to estimate stress. Photos are processed on your device when face detection is available.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: PeacePlot uses the back camera and flash to measure a short finger pulse signal for stress check-ins.

plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: PeacePlot uses on-device speech recognition only to turn your short voice check-in into text for stress estimation—not for background listening.
plugins.microphonePermission: PeacePlot uses the microphone only to record short voice samples for stress check-ins—not for music or background listening.
